# Workspace Instructions

- This is a browser-only React and TypeScript app built with Vite. Keep data local and mocked; do not add a backend, database, authentication, AI API, OCR, or persistence.
- Keep feature pages on client-side routes and reuse the shared shell and data-driven page patterns where practical.
- Preserve semantic HTML, keyboard access, visible focus, screen-reader names, high contrast, and responsive behavior. Never use color as the only status cue.
- Keep styles in `src/platform.css` and follow the existing component and naming conventions.
- Before handing off UI changes, run `npm run build` and `npm run lint`.
